finding: Forward/backward/affine formulas exposed channel assembly and tile addresses; forward connection used raw-port proof plumbing in the reader.
resolution: Named X/weight/bias/upstream/saved-stat inputs and Y/inverse/mean/affine-gradient outputs with complete bijections; raw connection proof moved to Proofs/ReaderConnections.
mathematical_target: Logical-N row mean/variance, affine normalization, saved-stat backward gradient, and all-row DW/DB sums.
conditions_and_scope: Existing N≤B for forward/backward; B remains the masked tile width. Bias mode, N=0 total Real semantics, affine row loop and independent DW/DB masks unchanged; no new input guards.
proof_connection: LogicalIO.forward_iff/backward_iff/affine_iff to the complete old ProgramIO judgments; ReaderConnections.forward proves the exact displayed mean/variance target relation.
fp_review: Existing forward/backward X-index candidates and affine inactive-select removal, all source masks and FP32 operation order preserved; stale compiled IOPair closure refreshed from current source.

numerical_dependencies.note: Existing actual source pair retained; no numerical operation/order rewrite or new admission obligation. Empty experimental rules do not assert arbitrary opaque-model/hardware identity.

previous_formula_scope.mathematical_target: Visible mean over range N, variance over range N, r=1/sqrt(variance+eps), Y=((x-mu)*r)*w+b; DX=(q-sum(q)/N-z*sum(q*z)/N)*savedR; affine DW=sum_rows dy*((x-savedMu)*savedR), DB=sum_rows dy.
required_conditions: Forward/backward retain N≤B; backward saved mean and r are independent inputs, not hidden forward-run premises.
Source-level total Real formulas retain N=0 behavior; checked host Contract separately requires positive bounded width and positive finite epsilon.
IO exposes input column masks, scalar statistic reads on every affine loop row, independent output masks, bounds/bindings and exact frame; no full-grid claim is introduced.
previous_formula_scope.scope: Three existing per-program scopes: a forward row with Y/r/mu outputs, a backward row, and a 128-column affine block looping over every row. N is logical width, B is padded tile. Affine DW/DB output counts wc/bc and optional bias mask remain independent of the input-column N test.
previous_formula_scope.canonical_connection: Function-extensional equality connects forwardFormula to Interface.forwardMath using RealProof mean/variance/inverse/output definitions and finite extension. Backward and affine displayed formulas are definitionally equal to canonical targets; Interface.forward_real/backward_real/affine_real supply full execution/IO proofs.
